security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from documented MaxHub URLs, placeholder API key setup, Markdown code formatting, and API parameter tables. I found one high-severity semantic issue: the Channels reference gives procedural guidance for decrypting protected WeChat video media. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions and links that explain how to decrypt WeChat video files. Add a clear rule that the skill must not bypass platform access controls.

remediation.issue: Data access boundaries are not explicit
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should query only public or authorized content and must follow WeChat and MaxHub terms.
Instruct assistants to URL-encode parameters and avoid direct shell interpolation of user input in curl commands.

remediation.issue: Credential handling depends on user configuration
remediation.suggestion: Keep MAXHUB_API_KEY in sensitive config or environment variables. Never echo, log, or include the value outside the MaxHub Authorization header.

semantic_findings.title: Guidance to Decrypt Protected WeChat Video Media
semantic_findings.description: The Channels API reference tells users to combine returned video links with tokens, download encrypted MP4 files, and use decode_key with an external decryption tool. This can help bypass platform media protections and extract protected content beyond normal viewing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation explicitly mentions encrypted MP4 files, decode_key values, and a third-party decryption tool. The language is instructional rather than incidental, so the abuse risk is clear.

content.user_title: Analyze WeChat Public Data with MaxHub
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable WeChat public data for content and account analysis. This skill queries MaxHub endpoints for Channels and Official Accounts and summarizes results.
actual_capabilities: Search WeChat Channels content, users, hot topics, and latest results through MaxHub endpoints.
Retrieve Channels video details, comments, live history, home pages, and share URL details.
Query Official Account articles, article lists, article details, comments, replies, ads, and read counts.
Route user intent between Channels, Official Account, and deeper multi-endpoint analysis workflows.
Produce bilingual summaries with tables, source links, formatted numbers, and next-step suggestions.
limitations: Requires a valid MaxHub API key and network access to www.aconfig.cn.
Data quality, coverage, and freshness depend on the third-party MaxHub API.
Some endpoints may return empty data, permission errors, rate limits, or server errors.
It should not be used to bypass platform controls or decrypt protected media.

use_cases.title: Monitor Official Account Content
use_cases.description: Track article lists, topics, comments, and reading signals for public Official Accounts.

use_cases.title: Analyze Channels Video Performance
use_cases.description: Review public Channels videos, comments, user pages, and engagement patterns for campaign reporting.

use_cases.title: Research WeChat Topic Activity
use_cases.description: Search public WeChat content and compare results across Channels and Official Account sources.

prompt_templates.title: Find Public WeChat Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Search WeChat for public results about [topic]. Show the most relevant Channels and Official Account results with short summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Recent Articles
prompt_templates.prompt: Find recent articles from the Official Account [account name]. Summarize themes, titles, links, and visible engagement signals.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Channels Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this WeChat Channels video or share link: [link or video id]. Include details, comments, and key engagement observations.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Accounts and Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [account or topic A] with [account or topic B] across WeChat Channels and Official Accounts. Highlight content strategy, audience response, and evidence gaps.

output_examples.input: Search WeChat Channels for electric vehicle launch videos this week.
output_examples.output: A concise ranked list of relevant public videos, each with title, account, visible engagement, source link, and a short trend summary.

output_examples.input: Analyze recent articles from a public Official Account.
output_examples.output: A table of recent articles, followed by topic clusters, reading signal notes, comment themes, and suggested follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Compare two WeChat accounts for a campaign report.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side comparison of posting patterns, content formats, interaction signals, notable examples, and limitations in the available data.

best_practices: Configure the API key through sensitive settings or environment variables before running queries.
Use specific account names, article links, video links, or topics to reduce irrelevant results.
Review source links and note API limitations before making business decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API key values into prompts, shared chats, logs, or output examples.
Do not use the skill to request private, restricted, or unauthorized WeChat data.
Do not use the skill to bypass WeChat controls or decrypt protected video files.

faq.question: What data sources does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses MaxHub API endpoints for WeChat Channels and Official Accounts.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a MaxHub API key configured as MAXHUB_API_KEY or through supported skill settings.

faq.question: Can it analyze both Chinese and English requests?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to respond in the same language as the user.

faq.question: Can it guarantee complete WeChat coverage?
faq.answer: No. Coverage depends on MaxHub API availability, permissions, rate limits, and returned data.

faq.question: Is it safe to share the API key in a prompt?
faq.answer: No. Store the key in sensitive configuration or an environment variable, and never include the value in chat.

faq.question: Can it decrypt protected WeChat videos?
faq.answer: It should not be used for decryption or bypassing platform protections. Use only authorized public data workflows.
